subject: Service stability remedy package & trial sweetener
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@brightline.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com
Cc: platform@brightline.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production latency spike impacting search indexers (Nov 16)

Hi Aditya —

Quick note from Brightline ops: on Nov 16 our nightly search reindex job experienced repeated token timeouts and large tail latency spikes between ~03:02-03:47 UTC which caused backfills to fail for multiple warehouses. We centralised the alerts and our SREs traced the issue to token request throttling against your hosted inference endpoint (model: redwood-llama-13b-cpu-quant).

This resulted in delayed shipments for retail customers and a follow-up incident with our downstream analytics. Our ops lead asked I escalate for a remedial package: token credits to offset overage, a short trial extension while we validate stability, and a written incident summary so we can close our internal Postmortem.

Can you confirm what remediation you can offer and an estimate for when your logs/report will be available? I attached a segment of our job logs for the affected window (attached: incident_report_nov16.pdf).

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of Platform Reliability
Brightline Logistics

[attachment: incident_report_nov16.pdf (log excerpt, text)]

From: aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Production latency spike impacting search indexers (Nov 16) — remedial package suggestion

Team — forwarding Brightline's escalation (see attached). Key asks: token credits, trial extension window, and incident report. Initial notes from infra: we had an autoscaler thrash during that UTC window due to a coordinated burst from several noisy tenants; fallback routing to a lower-tier model triggered extra queuing. We've already applied a routing tweak and a metrics instrumentation to trace prefix cache behavior.

Proposed customer remedy (draft):
- One-time token credit equivalent to $12,000 (applied as account credit)
- 2-month trial extension on their current trial plan (to validate stability under production load)
- Priority 2 postmortem with a consolidated log bundle and timeline delivered within 72 hours

I've attached a simple schedule and credit calc (proposed_credit_schedule.xlsx). Please review quickly so I can send to Marta today.

Questions: Lauren — do we need GC/finance signoff for $12k one-off credit? Sean — can we mark this as a sales-driven appeasement (no precedent docs needed) or do you want legal review first? Marissa — you'll own the follow-through on the trial extension + monitoring hook.

Thanks — Adi
Adi (Aditya Rao)
Senior Account Manager, Escalations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: proposed_credit_schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@brightline.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:24:00 -0800
Subject: Stabilty remedy proposal and trial extension (Brightline)

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for the quick escalation and the log excerpt. We took a deep look and want to propose a remedial package we hope addresses both the immediate cost/ops impact and your ability to validate stability:

Proposal summary:
- One-time account credit of $12,000 (to offset the spike/cleanup)
- Trial extension: add 60 days to your existing trial/PO window so your team can rerun reindex workloads under our patched routing configuration
- Priority postmortem: consolidated timeline and log bundle within 72 hours, plus a short review call with our infra engs

Next steps if you accept: we can route a small DocuSign addendum to apply the credit and extend the trial; credits are applied immediately on signature. I've attached the proposed credit schedule and a draft addendum flow.

If you prefer a different sizing (e.g., token credits instead of dollar credit), tell us your preferred form and we'll adjust. We're committed to making this right.

Cheers,
Adi
Senior Account Manager, Escalations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: proposed_credit_schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@brightline.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com
Cc: platform@brightline.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stabilty remedy proposal and trial extension (Brightline)

Adi — appreciate the clear proposal. The $12k credit + 60-day extension is reasonable. Two asks before we sign:
1) Please include a short confirmation in the DocuSign addendum that the routing change is non-invasive and has been validated against our reindex workload (a one-paragraph statement from infra is fine).
2) Can you confirm credits will be visible in our billing UI and that they will not affect our usage quotas (we need them applied as a billing offset)?

If you can update the addendum with that language, we can sign and return within the day.

Thanks — Marta

[one-line reply]

From: aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Brightline — DocuSign sent and credits queued

Quick internal update — Marta signed the addendum this morning (DocuSign completed). The signed agreement is attached (signed_remedy_agreement.pdf). Finance confirmed the $12,000 one-time credit has been queued and will appear on their next billing cycle as a line-item 'Customer Remediation Credit' (not a quota change). Marissa — please activate the 60-day trial extension and add the monitoring hook (we discussed the alert rule).

Lauren — no legal escalation required for this one-off under our sales remediation guidelines. Sean — please flag on the deal so AMs know this customer's goodwill resolution.

Thanks,
Adi
Senior Account Manager, Escalations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: signed_remedy_agreement.pdf (signed DocuSign addendum)]
